m1-property-mixture.title: New src/physics/layer2/property_mixture.py: MixtureFit, fit_property_mixture, posterior_membership
m1-property-mixture.imperative: Create src/physics/layer2/property_mixture.py with: module-level constant MIN_COMPONENT_WEIGHT_FRAC = 0.05 (documented: pre-registered before any real-data fit exists, per pre-ruling #1 support-driven class count, Gates 3/4 will import this exact constant); a frozen dataclass MixtureFit carrying gmm (the fitted sklearn.mixture.GaussianMixture), k (int), scaler (the fitted StandardScaler), and bic_scores (dict[int, float] per candidate k tried); fit_property_mixture(descriptors: np.ndarray, k_range: tuple[int,int] = (2,6), min_component_weight_frac: float = MIN_COMPONENT_WEIGHT_FRAC, random_state: int = 0) -> MixtureFit implementing: standardize descriptors with StandardScaler, for each k in range(k_range[0], k_range[1]+1) fit GaussianMixture(n_components=k, random_state=random_state) on standardized data, reject any k whose weights_.min() < min_component_weight_frac, among surviving candidates pick lowest-BIC k, if every k is rejected fall back to k=1 (fit a single-component GaussianMixture, not raise); posterior_membership(fit: MixtureFit, descriptors: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray shape (N, fit.k), each row summing to 1, via fit.gmm.predict_proba on descriptors transformed by the SAME stored fit.scaler (not a re-fit scaler). Both functions carry docstrings citing why standardization matters (radius in meters vs lateral_g in O(1) g-units) and why the support floor exists (pre-ruling #1: class count is support-driven, not fixed). Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_property_mixture.py: TDD red first (write tests before implementation, observe failing via manual run, attest c1 as red evidence) covering: 2-cluster well-separated synthetic Gaussian blobs -> fit.k == 2; 3-cluster well-separated blobs -> fit.k == 3; a thin/unsupported blob scenario where a candidate k's split would create a component below MIN_COMPONENT_WEIGHT_FRAC -> selection does not pick that k (assert against the floor behavior, e.g. lower k selected or documented fallback); posterior_membership rows sum to 1 via np.allclose; MIN_COMPONENT_WEIGHT_FRAC equals exactly 0.05 (regression-pin the constant's value per the handoff's Authority section -- do not let a test silently want a different number). Do not modify MIN_COMPONENT_WEIGHT_FRAC's value to fit a test; adjust fixtures instead.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: test_property_mixture.py written, observed failing (module/functions do not exist yet) -- manual attest
property_mixture.py implemented; all test_property_mixture.py cases pass (2-cluster k==2, 3-cluster k==3, thin-blob floor behavior, posterior rows sum to 1, constant pinned at 0.05)

constraints: MIN_COMPONENT_WEIGHT_FRAC = 0.05 exactly, not tuned by any real-data fit
mixtures fit on STANDARDIZED (radius, lateral_g) features
posterior_membership reuses the stored fit-time scaler, never re-fits one
every-k-rejected falls back to k=1, never raises, never silently picks a rejected k
no DB I/O, pure functions/synthetic fixtures only

m2-soft-class-membership.title: SegmentClassifier.soft_class_membership additive method
m2-soft-class-membership.imperative: Edit src/physics/segment_classifier.py: add ONE new method soft_class_membership(self, sample: KinematicSample, fit: 'MixtureFit') -> Optional[np.ndarray] importing MixtureFit/posterior_membership from src.physics.layer2.property_mixture and GRAVITY_MS2 from src.physics.constants. Returns None when sample.regime != 'corner'. For a corner sample: derive radius = 1.0 / sample.curvature when abs(sample.curvature) > 1e-9, else return None (degenerate zero-curvature corner-regime edge case); lateral_g = sample.a_lateral / GRAVITY_MS2 (note: this is DIVIDING by G, unlike corner_descriptors.py's bin_row_to_descriptor which takes mu_lat_p90 already in g-units -- sample.a_lateral is m/s^2, different unit convention, document this distinction in the method docstring to prevent future confusion between the two call sites). Call posterior_membership(fit, np.array([[radius, lateral_g]])) and return the single-row result as a 1-D array (or the 2-D row -- your call, document it). Do NOT modify _classify_regime, _VALID_REGIMES, or any other existing method/behavior; do NOT wire soft_class_membership into classify_samples's main loop. Add test cases to tests/unit/physics/test_segment_classifier.py (TDD red first: write cases, observe failing, attest c1) covering: a corner sample with valid curvature returns a membership array summing to 1 (use a small synthetic MixtureFit built via fit_property_mixture on a synthetic 2-cluster descriptor set for the test); a straight-regime sample (any of straight_throttle/straight_coast/straight_brake) returns None; a corner-regime sample with curvature == 0.0 (or abs < 1e-9) returns None (degenerate case). Do not remove or weaken any existing test in the file.
